question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Matter which is against moral values
solution:
The correct answer is **Immoral.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Immoral: **Matter which is** **considered wrong or not honest by most people.
 
• Hence, the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words is **'****Immoral'**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mortal:** unable to continue living forever.
 
• **Immortal: **living or lasting forever.
 
• **Amorous:** showing sexual desire and love for somebody.
